name: Additional Combat Style
body:
You have combat experience far beyond that of a normal ranger.

Prerequisite: Ranger level 11.

Benefit: You gain the benefits of an additional combat style (archery, musketeer, or two-weapon fighting). All normal restrictions of this class feature apply.
